heroSubtitle: Dubai Marina is one of the city's most desirable business addresses: a waterfront district of towers, restaurants, and professionals, located minutes from DMCC's Jumeirah Lakes Towers (JLT) cluster and Dubai Media City.

whyChooseSection.title: A Waterfront Business Address
whyChooseSection.paragraph: Companies setting up in the Marina usually choose a free zone license from the nearby JLT authorities, a mainland DED license, or one of the city's business districts — each with different costs and permissions.

costGuideSection.title: Typical Marina Setup Costs
costGuideSection.paragraph1: A free zone license for a Marina-based services company typically lands between AED 9,000 and AED 15,000 including the trade license, activity fees, and a flexi-desk.
costGuideSection.paragraph2: Adding a residency visa raises the total by roughly AED 5,000–8,000 (visa, Emirates ID, medical, and typing).
costGuideSection.note: Mainland costs start higher because of the mandatory office lease.

items.q: Can I use a Marina residential address as my business address?
items.a: Free zones require their own registered address (typically a flexi-desk or office). A residential apartment cannot serve as the licensed commercial address.

items.q: Is Dubai Marina in a free zone?
items.a: No – the Marina itself is mainland Dubai. Businesses use the surrounding free zones (DMCC JLT, Media City) or a mainland DED license.

items.q: What is the fastest way to get a Marina business license?
items.a: A DMCC free zone license can be issued within a week when documents are complete.

items.q: Do I need to visit Dubai to incorporate?
items.a: No – most free zones allow remote setup with electronic document processing and a representative on the ground.

quickAnswersSection.title: Quick Answers
quickAnswersSection.subtitle: Common questions about business setup in Dubai. Still have questions? We're one message away.

items.q: How much does it cost to start a business in Dubai?
items.a: Business setup in Dubai starts from AED 9,500 for a basic free zone license. Mainland setup starts from AED 14,500.

items.q: Can a foreigner 100% own a company in Dubai?
items.a: Yes, foreigners can 100% own companies in most free zones and many mainland activities.

items.q: What is the cheapest free zone in Dubai?
items.a: RAK ICC, Ajman FTZ, and SRTIP offer the most affordable packages starting from AED 5,900.

items.q: How long does company registration take in Dubai?
items.a: Free zone registration takes 3-7 business days. Mainland takes 2-4 weeks.

items.q: Do I need a local partner in Dubai?
items.a: Not in free zones. In mainland, many activities now allow 100% foreign ownership.
